May we proceed with updating the charger to the new firmware? After the update, please attempt to charge the device. Should you encounter any issues, kindly inform us so that we may investigate further.
Thank you for your cooperation. We look forward to your response.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
